name: Cost-to-Serve Diagnostic

returns: Designs pallet-layer MOQ & bracket incentives to fix margin-dilutive small orders Stages policy-checked action via ERP Order Management (SD / MCP) Customer MOQ / Bracket Pricing Policy Update & Enterprise ERP (MCP / On-Prem DB) Sourcing Assignment Split.
stops_at: Never commits unapproved SAP IBP ledger mutations or overrides safety/contract policy without human sign-off.
